name: Processed Status 7 Code
definition: Processing status of the corporate action notification advice coming from the issuer agent.

SENT.name: Sent To Market
SENT.definition: The advice has been sent to the market.

SNAV.name: System Not Available
SNAV.definition: System is not available. Instruction is sent outside of business hours.

WARN.name: Accepted With Warning
WARN.definition: The announcement has been accepted but another source has provided different information.

PEND.name: Pending
PEND.definition: The processing of the request is pending.
